description: This file contains code for generating a dimension-wise accounts balance report in an ERP system, including data retrieval, processing, and formatting functions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to execute the report, validating filters and retrieving data.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves account data, processes GL entries, and prepares report data.

methods.name: set_gl_entries_by_account
methods.description: Fetches GL entries for each dimension item and associates them with accounts.

methods.name: format_gl_entries
methods.description: Formats GL entries and updates account data with dimension values.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Prepares the final report data structure from account data.

methods.name: accumulate_values_into_parents
methods.description: Aggregates child account values into parent accounts.

methods.name: get_condition
methods.description: Builds SQL condition string based on filters and dimension.

methods.name: get_dimension_items_list
methods.description: Retrieves list of dimension items for the report.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report table.
